import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy

async def main():
    # The target can be:
    # - An existing FastMCP server instance: create_proxy(backend_server)
    # - A URL string: create_proxy("http://localhost:8000")
    # - A stdio transport: create_proxy("stdio://backend_server_script.py")
    # - A Path to a server script: create_proxy(Path("server.py"))
    # - A Client instance: create_proxy(client)
    
    # Example 1: Proxy to an in-memory FastMCP server instance
    # Uncomment and replace with your actual backend server instance:
    # proxy = create_proxy(backend_server_instance)
    
    # Example 2: Proxy to a remote server via HTTP
    proxy = create_proxy("http://localhost:8000")
    
    async with proxy:
        await proxy.wait()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
